mutations.name: checkCandidates defaults to off when absent
the config accepts seat-waives before its resolver path exists
kills: loadConfig reads the non-source NO_REPRO key, and rejects seat-waives until its resolver path exists

mutations.name: the visual threshold refuses mode on, so nothing can decide on it
kills: loadConfig keeps a visual threshold mode of on, refuses an unknown mode, and caps the measuring work config can ask for

mutations.name: the review-check login takes any string
mutations.find: login: z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*\[bot\]$/, "a GitHub App's bot login, for example my-app[bot]").optional(),
kills: loadConfig rejects "my-app" as the review-check App's login, which must be a bot login

mutations.name: the release App login takes a bare slug a user could register
mutations.find: releaseAppLogin: z.string().regex(/^[^\s[\]]+\[bot\]$/, "must be an App's <app-slug>[bot] login").optional(),
kills: loadConfig reads an App's [bot] login as shepherd.releaseAppLogin and refuses a bare slug, which a user could register
